fusions.name: Sprung Snap
fusions.desc: Springs your jaws out at an enemy up to 5 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Fall From a Height
fusions.desc: You leap high and come down shell-first where you stood, which deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1.2 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Infested Challenge
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. Fleas pour out of your shell and fight beside you for 9 seconds, striking for 3 every 1 second.

fusions.name: Bite Back Harder
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, 25% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
